title: Synthesis and preliminary assessment of fluorescent probes based on the competitive GPCR antagonists vismodegib and masupirdine
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,17745-17752
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01214K, Paper

Carlson Alexander, Tsz-Lam Cheung, Chowan Ashok Kumar, Catherine H. H. Hor, Huishan Li, Xiuzhi Zou, David Parker
Synthesis, cell viability and imaging of the first family of fluorescent conjugates (1,8-naphthalimide, cyanine-5, Alexa-532), based on vismodegib and masupirdine (competitive antagonists for GPCR) is reported.
